name: Dragonborn Chosen of Tiamat

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Greatspear
items.description: This reach weapon resembles a longspear, but its broad head and strong haft allow it to strike with increased force.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Draconic Majesty
traits.details: While in the aura, an unmarked enemy that willingly leaves the aura or makes an attack that fails to target a dragonborn that has this aura active provokes an opportunity attack from the dragonborn.

traits.name: Inopportune Doom
traits.details: A creature the dragonborn hits with an opportunity attack loses all resistances (save ends).

traits.name: Tiamat’s Fury
traits.details: While bloodied, the dragonborn gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls and a +5 bonus to damage rolls.
